signature: MACHT ♦ ANTONII ♦ SCHNITZ [master’ mark: crown] M ♦ D ♦ LXXXXVIII [shield]
dimensions: bo1 12.5 (somewhat misshapen), bo2 13, mp receiver 13.5, be 115, le 3221.5 (including new piece joining slide and bell sections, 3269), ext. tube before bell bow 16, ext. tube after bell bow 14.5.
provenance: On loan for several years to D-Ms
remarks: Beautiful workmanship. Flat slide stays with dragon-head hinges; moveable slide stay elaborately decorated with ?bridge over water, trees; immoveable slide stay plain. Brass handle with ivory knob attached to moveable slide stay. Two sleeves 29.5 mm long adjacent to immovable slide stay; these sleeves are plain except for elaborately decorated ends; this stay is detached on side of ascending tube. Ring in slide bow, mounted on saddle. No ring or saddle in bell bow. Brass patch (26 x 17) in bell. Collar 32mm long begins 260mm from bell end. Saddle mounted on bell, with hole, perhaps for music lyre? Examined by Carter, June 1999.
